hypothesis: M185 is a positive single-seed PPO smoke from M184, but one seed is not enough to admit a longer PPO stage. Repeating the same conservative recipe across fresh seeds should show whether the M185 retention result is stable.
success_criteria: reuse the M185 recipe without relaxing replay thresholds
start from M184 for every repeat, not from the M185 seed-5185 checkpoint
run only PPO smoke repeats, not a longer stage
preserve M168 and M170 M183 boundary replay success-drop counts for every accepted repeat
preserve behavior success on seeds 9503 and 9504
decide whether a staged PPO extension is admitted
failure_criteria: chain repeats from M185 instead of independently initializing from M184
accept a repeat that loses any M183 boundary success-drop row
relax behavior or protected-key thresholds after seeing the results
promote to long PPO based on one repeat
